item.name: Ghost
item.subject: The ghost itself, including Laser Projector silhouettes and ghost-event manifestations.
item.howToGet: Photograph the ghost while it is visible during a hunt, a ghost event, or a Laser Projector silhouette. Lighting the Summoning Circle or using the Show yourself prompt gives a short safe window.
item.cardSummary: The highest-value photo. Shoot the ghost, a Laser Projector silhouette, or a manifestation, and fill the frame for the full payout.

item.name: Burnt Cross
item.subject: A Cross that already stopped a hunt and is burnt, or is still burning.
item.howToGet: Place a Cross, wait until it blocks a hunt, then photograph it while it burns or after it is spent. Crouch so the Cross fills the frame.
item.cardSummary: A burnt or still-burning Cross is one of the best farmable photos. Get close so it fills the shot.

item.name: Corpse
item.subject: The ragdoll of a hunter who died on the job.
item.howToGet: Photograph a slain hunter's body before the job ends.
item.cardSummary: A dead hunter's ragdoll is a high-value subject, so keep a slot free if someone goes down.

item.name: Friendly Fire
item.subject: A hunter stunned on the ground after being shot by the Rock Salt Shotgun.
item.howToGet: Shoot a teammate with the Rock Salt Shotgun, then photograph them while they are stunned on the ground.
item.cardSummary: A teammate stunned by the Rock Salt Shotgun is a high-value photo if you shoot them before they get up.

item.name: Broken Glass
item.subject: Shattered glass on the ground.
item.howToGet: Photograph the shards after the ghost breaks a window, mirror, or other glass.
item.cardSummary: Broken glass on the floor pays the same as a burnt Cross, so photograph the shards after a break.

item.name: Withered Flowers
item.subject: Wither evidence on the Flower Pot only.
item.howToGet: Place the Flower Pot, wait until the flowers wilt, then photograph the pot. Rusted metal and distorted paintings do not pay this caption.
item.cardSummary: Only the wilted Flower Pot counts. Other Wither damage on metal or paintings does not pay this photo.

item.name: Ghost Writing
item.subject: Writing on the Spirit Book or inscription carvings on walls.
item.howToGet: Photograph the Spirit Book after the ghost writes in it, or shoot wall carvings that count as Inscription.
item.cardSummary: Shoot book writing or wall carvings. The journal caption still says Ghost Writing even though the evidence is now Inscription.

item.name: Handprints
item.subject: A handprint, footprint, or fingerprint left by the ghost.
item.howToGet: Reveal prints with a Blacklight, then photograph them. Disturbed salt is a reliable place to check.
item.cardSummary: Any print revealed by a Blacklight counts. The evidence type is now called Prints.

item.name: Disturbed Salt
item.subject: A Salt Canister line the ghost has stepped on.
item.howToGet: Lay a salt line, wait for the ghost to walk through it, then photograph the disturbed salt. Crouch so the line fills the frame.
item.cardSummary: Photograph the salt line after the ghost walks through it, and get close so the line fills the shot.

item.name: Cursed Object
item.subject: Any Cursed Object that still counts as one.
item.howToGet: Photograph the object before using it. A broken Umbra Board no longer counts, and a lit Summoning Circle can be read as a Ghost photo instead.
item.cardSummary: Shoot cursed objects while they still count. Photograph the Umbra Board and Summoning Circle before you activate them.

item.name: Interaction
item.subject: An object the ghost threw or interacted with, not objects moved by a ghost event.
item.howToGet: Photograph a thrown or recently interacted object soon after the ghost touches it. Skip objects that only floated during a ghost event.
item.cardSummary: Shoot an object the ghost threw or touched. Floating objects from a ghost event do not count.
